claim: AW22 / A-049 (analytics walk 2026-10-03): /calendar dropped the takings its own API returned. At 8c673db4b the gateway summed the GROSS pos_checks.total into recorded.sales (recorded-days.service.ts:129-130, select :165) and no web file drew it, so the $7,709.52 street-fair booth changed nothing on the page. ADR 0287 (Locked on the founder's AW22 'Day panel only (Recommended)' and AW17 'Net sales (Recommended)'; the audience is F1 option (b), decided by citation of the founder's money rule, ADR 0253 rounds 10-11 on #566, 'owners and managers get it and some authorized staff', no ask [Corrected 2026-10-08, coordinator: this said his confirmation of the (b) reading was owed; the rule is his, so none is; 2026-10-07 had already struck 'Locked on ... his F1 answer']): the opened day (DayLedger: month panel and Day view) shows NET takings, the sum of pos_checks.subtotal, in the house currency, beside covers, to owners and managers; the month cell stays covers-only; any role below manager, or none, gets the days with netSales, netSalesCheckCount and currency omitted and takingsWithheld: true. The verify strips comments and requires (1) recorded-days.service.ts's one pos_checks money read (the select('id') probe aside) selects subtotal and no total column, with or without the select's options argument; (2) foldChecksToDays reads row.subtotal and names no total at all; (3) day-record.service.ts's prediction_outcomes actual_value writes netSales from d.recorded?.netSales and no bare sales key; (4) SkyMark.tsx exports TakingsMark reading netSales while DayRecordMark's body never names netSales; (5) MonthLedger.tsx draws <TakingsMark inside DayLedger and names TakingsMark nowhere in the month grid; (6) calendar.controller.ts getDayRecord sets seesHouseMoney = roleSatisfies(user.role, "manager") and passes it to windowFor, with no literal true/false; (7) day-record.service.ts windowFor returns withholdHouseMoney(window) unless seesHouseMoney === true, and withholdHouseMoney's allowlist names no netSales or currency and sets takingsWithheld: true; (8) TakingsMark returns null when withheld and DayLedger passes withheld from takingsWithheld; (9) that read projects id, asks count: "exact" and is the build() of a readWholeWindow call (ADR 0292, merged in #609), so a month past PostgREST's 1,000 rows is summed whole or refused; (10) day-record.service.ts calls keepPairs once, only when the ledger's refusal is null, else pairsWritten is 0, so a refused register never freezes a pair; (11) TakingsMark, after the withheld check and before it reads day.recorded, draws under refused, on a day that holds a record, the em dash and 'net sales could not be read' with no netSales and no takings() call (ADR 0287 F3, decided 2026-10-08), and DayLedger passes refused from the window's recordedRefusal. (12) [added 2026-10-08, ADR 0287 F4] recorded-days.service.ts returns no literal posConnected: false (a refused read or a failed probe is posConnected: null), day-record.service.ts sets const posConnected = ledger.refusal === null ? ledger.posConnected : null and passes that posConnected to reconciliationLine, reconciliationLine tests posConnected === null before recorded?.excluded and before posConnected === false and says 'The sales register could not be read', and SkyMark.tsx's DayRecordMark draws 'covers could not be read' under refused while MonthLedger.tsx passes refused={!!data.record.window?.recordedRefusal} to DayRecordMark twice (the panel and the month cell). Mutation-checked: main's copy of each of the five files, and a select adding total, a fold falling back to total, a pairs row writing sales or dropping netSales, DayRecordMark reading netSales, the cell drawing TakingsMark, the role check forced true (|| true, = true, seesHouseMoney: true), the allowlist copying netSales, windowFor returning the full window, the web guard removed and the withheld prop dropped, each exit 1; on 2026-10-07 at the head after #609, twelve more each exit 1 (the select naming total, adding total, dropping id, dropping or changing count: "exact", readWholeWindow renamed; keepPairs unguarded, its guard inverted, a second keepPairs call; the refused guard removed, the refused prop dropped or set false), and on 2026-10-08, after item 11 was rewritten for F3, seven more each exit 1 (the refused branch returning null, the refused check moved above the withheld one, the branch drawing takings(), the tag reading 'net sales not recorded', the figure a 0 in place of the em dash, the refused prop dropped, and main's SkyMark.tsx), and main's copy of each of the five files still exits 1. On 2026-10-08 round 3, after item 12 was added for F4, nine more each exit 1: posConnected: false restored in the WholeReadError catch, and in the failed-probe branch; the window passing ledger.posConnected through; reconciliationLine handed ledger.posConnected; its null branch made dead (&& false); its false branch widened to !posConnected; DayRecordMark's refused tag reading 'covers not recorded'; and the refused prop dropped from the month cell's, and from the panel's, DayRecordMark. Behaviour is pinned by apps/api-gateway/src/calendar/day-record.spec.ts (net vs gross, null never 0, partial count, the select, currency readable/unreadable, the pairs key, and the route driven as owner, manager, staff, host, null and undefined, with the staff pair still written in full; and, since 2026-10-07, a PostgREST-shaped paged double: 2,121 checks summed whole, a part read refused, and that refusal reaching the day record with no recorded day and no pair written) and apps/web/src/pages/calendar/next/CalendarNext.test.tsx 'the opened day shows what it took, net' (since 2026-10-07 also the refusal sentence shown; since 2026-10-08 'net sales could not be read' under a refusal, with or without a recorded half, in the month panel and the Day view, and no takings mark for a withheld viewer under a refusal) [2026-10-08 round 3: day-record.spec.ts also pins posConnected null and the refused line under a whole-read refusal, a failed probe and a ledger that said true beside its refusal, and the same line and null in the staff window under a refusal; CalendarNext.test.tsx pins 'covers could not be read' in the panel and the month cell, never 'covers not recorded' or 'No sales register is connected', and a ruled-out day with checks still drawing its takings] [2026-10-08: this said 'no takings under a sales-register refusal', the state before F3]. Not checked here: that a POS adapter's subtotal is really net (Square tax-inclusive per its docs, Clover null; lane netsales) and the UTC business day (F-086). [2026-10-07: this also listed the 1,000-row read (C15); #609 closed it for this read, and item 9 checks the read is whole.]
